summary: Iteration 216 — Smoke verification of the 17 taxi modes via /course?mode=<id> on https://gojek-clone-41.preview.emergentagent.com using a freshly-registered client (test_iter216_1781032867@demo.sb / Client123!). All 17 routes render the unified RideChoosePage WITHOUT a crash (the [data-testid=ride-choose-page] container mounts for every mode). However, the broad end-to-end booking flow could NOT be reliably exercised from an automated Paris-pickup because the page auto-runs geolocation on mount: with the Playwright runner running from a US datacenter the pickup is set to a US coordinate, the address-entry form is hidden, the vehicle list immediately appears at the map step, and the resulting estimate is absurd (SB shown at 9 365,46 € / 21607 min — i.e. a transatlantic ride). This is exactly the failure mode the user warned about. ONE mode-specific React error was also observed: `<ModeSpecificPanel>` threw on /course?mode=intercity (`panel-intercity` never rendered, React logged 'An error occurred in the <ModeSpecificPanel> component').

ui_bugs.issue: React rendering error: 'An error occurred in the <ModeSpecificPanel> component. Consider adding an error boundary…' — [data-testid=panel-intercity] never mounts on /course?mode=intercity. Other panel-* (panel-rental, panel-buddy, panel-flight, panel-pets, panel-contact, panel-assist, panel-corporate, panel-pool, panel-bidding) appear to mount but were observed AFTER auto-geolocation had progressed the page past the address-entry step, so they could not be interacted with in this run (see integration issue below).

Auto-geolocation runs unconditionally on mount and overrides the user's intent. When the geolocation IP resolves to a non-FR location (e.g. a cloud datacenter), pickup is set thousands of km away from the Paris destination and the live estimate returns prices like 9 365,46 € / 21607 min for SB on /course?mode=standard&dlat=48.88&dlng=2.355&daddr=Gare%20du%20Nord. The address form (input[data-testid=ride-choose-pickup]) becomes hidden as soon as pickup is set, so the rider cannot easily correct it without first tapping back. The same pattern degrades every mode that needs a dropoff (12 of 17).

integration_issues.issue: Could not be auto-tested end-to-end because (a) the pickup input is hidden after auto-locate, (b) Google Places Autocomplete pac-container did not appear before the form hid itself, so the spec's recommended path (type → pick suggestion) is racing with auto-locate. Need either (i) disable auto-locate by default and let the rider pick manually, or (ii) keep the input mounted/editable even after pickup is set so the rider can override.

action_items: URGENT: Fix the ModeSpecificPanel render error on mode=intercity — panel-intercity component is throwing (likely a missing/undefined prop such as scheduledAt, scheduleLater, distanceKm, or intercityPerKm). Wrap the panel in an error boundary AND fix the root cause so the panel mounts.

URGENT: Make pickup auto-geolocation opt-in (or guard it to FR territory + reject when accuracy is poor). At minimum, do NOT auto-call autoLocate(true) on mount; let the user tap [data-testid=ride-choose-locate] manually, OR fall back to autoLocate ONLY when no IP geolocation resolves inside FR/DOM-TOM.

Keep [data-testid=ride-choose-pickup] and [data-testid=ride-choose-dropoff] mounted (collapsed/readonly is fine) once bothSet=true so the rider — and automated tests — can re-edit without having to navigate back.

Support pickup pre-fill via URL params (plat/plng/paddr), mirroring the existing dlat/dlng/daddr handling at line 99-102 of RideChoosePage.js. This unlocks deep-link bookings AND deterministic E2E tests.

After these fixes are in, re-run the per-mode smoke (test file already in place at /app/tests/test_all_17_modes.py) — adjust pick_first_pac() to use plat/plng/paddr URL params for the new pickup pre-fill instead of typing.
critical_code_review_comments: RideChoosePage.js renders the address-entry form ONLY while !bothSet (line ~914). Because dropoff is supplied via URL params (dlat/dlng/daddr) AND pickup is auto-set by the on-mount geolocation effect, bothSet flips to true immediately on every navigation and the input disappears before the rider — or Playwright — can type. This is the single point of failure preventing a clean smoke of the 17 modes.

ModeSpecificPanel (line ~960+) crashed on mode=intercity. Suspected: an unconditional access to a derived field (e.g. p.distanceKm or p.intercityPerKm) before the estimate has resolved, or an icon import mismatch (MapTrifold). Wrap in an error boundary and add a default {} to optional props.

GooglePlacesInput.js relies on the legacy `google.maps.places.Autocomplete` API which has been deprecated since March 1, 2025 (the warning is logged twice per render). Plan a migration to `PlaceAutocompleteElement` (or `AutocompleteSuggestion`) — not breaking today but worth scheduling.

Console floods: 6+ identical warnings per page load (Autocomplete deprecation x2, DirectionsService deprecation x2, DirectionsRenderer deprecation x2, Canvas2D willReadFrequently x3). Consider gating warnings to dev-only or fixing the underlying APIs.

rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE 1 (autoLocate fallback): RideChoosePage.js (around line 866 and an on-mount effect that calls autoLocate(true)) unconditionally requests the browser geolocation; when the browser cannot fulfil it (Playwright/headless), it falls back to an IP-based service which resolves to the SERVER's location (US datacenter for cloud runs). Pickup gets set to a US coordinate, dropoff is the Paris coordinate from URL params, and rideAPI.estimate then returns ~21 600 min / 9 365 € for SB — which the UI surfaces as-is. REPRO: open /course?mode=standard&dlat=48.88&dlng=2.355&daddr=Gare%20du%20Nord from any non-FR network → SB price ~9 365 €. MITIGATION: (i) Reject geolocation results whose country != FR/MQ/GP/GF/RE, (ii) Add a guard so autoLocate(true) is only called from the explicit user tap, not on mount, (iii) Support plat/plng/paddr URL pre-fill (mirrors the existing dlat/dlng/daddr handler at L99-102). ROOT CAUSE 2 (intercity panel crash): ModeSpecificPanel renders for mode=intercity but throws during render — React error boundary missing. Wrap ModeSpecificPanel in an ErrorBoundary and add defensive null-checks on the intercity-specific props (distanceKm, intercityPerKm, roundTrip).
